person: P-018 / DM-X-001, Mihály Demkó, baptised 20 Aug 1882
burials_searched: none: no burial register of the Csicser Greek Catholic parish or of the Roman Catholic parish for Viszoka, 1882 to 1897, is in hand
forward_search: The strips in hand for this couple end in 1882. No later Mihály to György Demkó is in hand; the mother was bearing by January 1857, so a child after 1882 is unlikely.
backward: An earlier Mihály, twin, born 29 May [1873], is marked with a cross (DM-D-013). The 1882 child is itself a reuse of that name. The two are kept as two people.
age_test: The father of 1906 is '24 (huszonnégy) éves' on 23 Aug 1906: born between 24 Aug 1881 and 23 Aug 1882. The child of 19 Aug 1882 fits; the twin of 1873 does not.
cousin_test: The 1906 record names no parents for him. A cousin Mihály born about 1881-82 to János Demkó of Viszoka no. 120 is not excluded by the strips in hand (gap between March 1879 and January 1883).
result: necronym risk: unresolved. Link capped at 70.

age_test: The gravestone gives 'born 1906'. No record gives her age at marriage or death.
result: necronym risk: unresolved. That Ahn 9 is the child of 1906 stays an agreement of name, village and year.

forward_search: All 58 strips of the folder checked by label, and the 28 held here read: no second Mária to Mihály Kocsis and Mária Knyezső; their next child in hand is Anna, October [1889]. The remarks cell of the [1887] entry is blank, in a book that notes infant deaths there on eight strips between 1875 and 1894.
age_test: Born February 1887: 19 in August 1906, where the civil record says 20.
result: Unresolved. Not attached to P-019. DM-H-031 is held at 58 and cannot pass 70 until a burial search or the marriage entry is seen.

rule: X-017 rule on two baptisms to the same parents
person: The blank entry no. 49 of 1870 and Anna Demko, no. 4 of January [1871], both to Michael Demko and Maria Lazár of Jesztreb no. 54
forward_search: Same parents, same house number, same godparents, three rows apart, and the first row has no name and no dates.
result: One child, entered once. The blank row is a false start overwritten with the new year. The Anna strip is redated from [1870] to [1871].

rule: X-017 rule on a change of mother's name
person: Children of 'Pál Kocsis' of Solymos: Borbála [1843] (Anna Cservenyák), Borbála [1846] (Mária Jevcsák), Mihály [1847 or 1848] (Anna Cservenyák)
forward_search: The [1846] strip was read again at a larger size; the mother is Mária Jevcsák.
result: The mothers alternate, so this is not a widower's second marriage. Either two men called Pál Kocsis held land at Solymos in the 1840s, or the [1846] entry names the wrong mother. Open. A second Borbála three years after the first is then no evidence that the first had died, if the fathers are two men.

person: Mária Demkó of Jesztreb, born [1888] to Mihály Demkó and Anna Jaros, against P-009 Maria Demko, born 1906 to Mihály Demkó and Mária Kocsis
age_test: Eighteen years apart; different mothers; different fathers (DM-H-033 against DM-H-010).
result: Two people. A record of a 'Mária Demkó, daughter of Mihály' from this parish must be placed by date and mother's name before it is given to either. The same holds for the Maria of [1864], aunt of the [1888] child.

result: Two women. A record of a 'Mary Demko, born 1906' from an American source must be placed by parents, husband or death before it is given to Ahn 9: there may have been a second one, born at Passaic.

rule: X-017 rule 6 (two people of one name)
person: Men named György Knyezső and Mihály Knyezső at Solymos, 1884 to 1910
forward_search: Wives' names in eleven baptisms: György with Dzsurina Mária, Tomócsik Anna, Kontra Anna and Dzsurina Anna; Mihály with Sárik Erzsébet, Onderko Anna and Sipos Erzsébet, and a Mihály 'Estók' with Dzsurina Zsuzsanna. Two Györgys are certainly alive together: each stands godparent to the other's son György (1890, 1894).
result: At least two men of each name, probably more. A 'Mihály Knyezső' met as a godfather or a father cannot be given to a household by name; it needs the wife or the house. The same holds for any Mária Knyezső.

rule: X-017 rule 6 (two people of one name)
person: The Kocsis of Senné (Roman Catholic) against the Kocsis of Solymos (Greek Catholic): Mária Kocsis, wife of Marczinko, 1909, against P-019; Mihály Kocsis and Anna Dzvonyik, 1895, against Mihály Kocsis of Solymos no. 19; János Kocsis and Anna Halász, 1891 and 1906, against János Kocsis and Anna Kováts of Solymos no. 13
age_test: Different rites, villages, wives and houses in every pair. The two Annas of János Kocsis and Anna Halász are two children: the first died in 1894, twelve years before the second was born.
result: Three pairs of namesakes four kilometres apart. None of the Senné people is attached to the line. A 'Mária Kocsis' or a 'Mihály Kocsis' from Senné is not to be given to Ahn 19 or to her candidate father without the rite and the spouse.

person: P-009, Maria Demko, against the Mária registered on 23 August 1906
burials_searched: none. No death register for Iňačovce after 1898 is known (PL-Q-006).
forward_search: Her passport of 1937 gives her birth as 22 August 1906 at Iňačovce (DM-D-093). The contract of November 1937 gives her age as 31 (DM-D-098). Her husband's application of September 1937 made her 28 (DM-D-096).
age_test: 31 in November 1937 fits August 1906. '28' does not; it is her husband's figure, in a letter that also makes the boy 7 when he was nearly 8.
result: The woman who emigrated carried the birth date of the 1906 entry. Still logged as unresolved, because the date on a passport comes from the register and a burial search has not been made; DM-H-024 is at 4.
